question: Banganga Festival, held every year in the city of Mumbai, is a musical tribute to________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Lord Rama**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Banganga Festival:**

 
 
• The **Banganga Festival** is an annual music festival held in Mumbai, Maharashtra, near the historic **Banganga Tank** in Malabar Hill.
 
• It is a **musical tribute to Lord Rama**, celebrating Indian classical music and culture.
 
• The festival is organized by the **MTDC (Maharashtra Tourism Development Corporation)** and features performances by renowned classical musicians.
 
• The Banganga Tank is believed to have been created by Lord Rama when he shot an arrow to draw water, linking it to his legacy.
 
• The festival attracts music enthusiasts and promotes India's rich cultural heritage.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Lord Brahma:**

 
 
• **Lord Brahma** is the Hindu god of creation and one of the Trimurti, along with Vishnu and Shiva.
 
• He is often depicted with four heads, symbolizing the four Vedas and the four directions.
 
• Temples dedicated to Lord Brahma are rare, with the most famous one located in **Pushkar, Rajasthan**.
 
• While Brahma is a significant deity in Hinduism, the Banganga Festival is not dedicated to him.
 
• The festival's focus is on Lord Rama and Indian classical music.
 
 
 
• **Lord Ganesh:**
 
 
• **Lord Ganesh**, the elephant-headed god, is widely worshipped as the remover of obstacles and the god of beginnings.
 
• He is a prominent deity in Maharashtra, with the **Ganesh Chaturthi** festival being a major celebration in Mumbai.
 
• However, the Banganga Festival is not associated with Lord Ganesh.
 
• The festival's theme revolves around Lord Rama and classical music traditions.
 
• Ganesh Chaturthi is a separate and widely celebrated event in Maharashtra.
 
 
 
• **Lord Shiva:**
 
 
• **Lord Shiva** is one of the principal deities of Hinduism, known as the destroyer and transformer within the Trimurti.
 
• He is worshipped in various forms, including as a yogi and the lord of dance (**Nataraja**).
 
• While Lord Shiva is deeply revered, the Banganga Festival is not dedicated to him.
 
• The festival's focus is on Lord Rama and the cultural heritage of Indian classical music.
 
• Shiva is associated with other festivals like **Maha Shivaratri**.
